create.name: Minna Sahlberg
create.bio:
Minna Sahlberg is a Finnish energy healer and Quantum-Touch teacher who runs Hoitohuone Aurinkoaamu, a quiet treatment and training room near the shore in the Aurinkolahti district of Helsinki. She qualified as a Quantum-Touch practitioner in 2011 and began teaching the Level 1 course in 2013, adding the Zoom version in 2020. She is the method's Finnish liaison and keeps up Kvanttikosketus, the shared site for Finland's practitioners and instructors. Along the way she has also trained in Reiki, the Access Bars and Body Process work, and intuitive energy healing.

Her sessions rest on grounding and awareness of the body, with Quantum-Touch at the heart of each one, and can be given on the couch in Helsinki, at a client's chosen place or at a distance. She teaches Level 1 mostly in Finnish, as weekend courses in her room or over four Zoom meetings, and gives the workshop in English on request. Beyond the formal method she gathers small circles of her own design: meditation, movement, sound and group energy work around the mystical heart and unity consciousness, and a pilot training in what she calls embodied unity alchemy.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 training (Helsinki and Zoom)
courses.description: The official two-day beginners' course, taught in Finnish in her Helsinki room or as four live Zoom meetings, with a Finnish student manual and registration with Quantum-Touch. Courses run most months; an English workshop can be arranged.
courses.price: 376 e pre-registration rate / 451 e full registration rate (incl. VAT 25.5%)

courses.title: Quantum-Touch and intuitive energy sessions
courses.description: Gentle hands-on or off-the-body sessions in Helsinki that start from grounding and body awareness, with Quantum-Touch as the base and Reiki or Access Bars added where it fits. Distance sessions are also offered.
courses.price: Distance: 30 min 40 e, 1 h 55 e; in person: 1 h 70 e, 1 h 30 min 100 e, 2 h 140 e

courses.title: Mystisen Sydämen Ruusu circles
courses.description: Small gatherings at her Helsinki room on the path of the mystical heart, combining guided meditation, group energy work, movement, sound and free dance. Each meeting has its own theme.

courses.title: Kehollistuneen Ykseyden Alkemia (pilot training)
courses.description: A pilot group training of her own on living unity consciousness in the body, through heart-centred energy work, presence and grounding. Level 1 Quantum-Touch is recommended beforehand.

courses.title: Kohtaaminen kvanttikentässä gatherings
courses.description: Meetings and circles in her Helsinki room for sharing presence, light and a felt sense of unity with others on the spiritual path.
